jurisdiction.venue: U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia

headline: Justice Department Files to Forfeit Over $1.1 Billion in Stablecoins Traced to $6 Billion Binance Hack
deck: Federal prosecutors in Washington filed a civil forfeiture complaint targeting more than $1.1 billion in Circle-issued USDC allegedly laundered by North Korean cyber actors after the Oct. 29 theft, bringing U.S.-assisted freezes and recoveries past $2.9 billion.

financials.prison_display: In Rem Civil Action (No Arrests Announced)

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: DOJ filed an in rem civil forfeiture complaint in D.D.C. targeting over $1.1 billion in Circle-issued USDC allegedly stolen and laundered by North Korean cyber actors in the Oct. 29 $6 billion Binance theft, with over $2.9 billion frozen, seized, or returned to date.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Clearing out $60 million from an armored-car depot in a single night while the central bank freezes $11 million of serialized bills before they cross the border
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Federal bank robbery and money-laundering warrants carrying decades in custody upon capture
